title_sq: Tek Ish Fusha E Aviacionit, Shitet Super Apartament 1+1 Me Planimetri Perfekte!!!

title_en: At the Former Aviation Field, Super Apartment 1+1 with Perfect Layout for Sale!!!
description_en: At the Former Aviation Field, Super Apartment 1+1 with Perfect Layout for Sale!!! The apartment is located on the 8th floor of an 8-story building with an elevator. The property has a gross area of ​​72.19 m2 and a net area of ​​62.44 m2. The apartment is organized in a living room with a kitchenette, 1 bedroom, and 1 bathroom. The orientation of the apartment is South-East, allowing natural lighting and views. The property also has 3 optional parking spaces with an extra price of 15,500 euros each. Currently, the construction is in the carabiner stage on the 6th floor and is expected to be completed within a period of 1.5-2 years.
